_comment: Year-agnostic seasonal windows (month-day, inclusive) with expected price multipliers per D7. A quote inside a window is compared against baseline * multiplier — expected seasonal lift is logged, not alerted. stem_multipliers override default_multiplier by stem_id. holiday_cutoff_lead_days: how many days before each holiday window's peak date the weekly digest starts surfacing vendor pre-order cutoffs (vendors.json holiday_cutoffs).

windows.name: Valentine's Day run-up
windows.notes: Rose prices roughly double; everything else drifts up ~20%.

windows.name: Mother's Day run-up
windows.notes: 2nd Sunday of May; May 14 is the latest it can fall, so the window is encoded Apr 20 - May 14.

windows.name: Wedding season
windows.notes: General ~15% demand lift. Peonies are IN season Apr 15 - Jun 30 (multiplier 1.0 — no expected lift while supply is up); dahlias are in season Jul-Oct (multiplier 1.0). Out-of-season quotes for these market-price stems are handled by the custom-quote flow, not the seasonal multiplier.

windows.name: Peony domestic season
windows.notes: Informational window: peony supply is up, prices at baseline. Outside this window peony is market-price.

windows.name: Dahlia domestic season
windows.notes: Informational window: dahlia supply is up, prices at baseline. Outside this window dahlia is market-price.
